prompts.title: Main: merge files
prompts.howTo: Paste in the chat with the files attached
prompts.body:
The {{파일개수}} attached Excel files are {{자료명}}. They all use the same layout, with headers in row {{머리글행}}.

Make one Excel file in this order:
1. 'Merged' sheet: stack the data from every file, add a 'Source file' column at the front, and keep the header only once.
2. 'Check' sheet: a table of data rows and the total of '{{합계열}}' for each source file, plus the grand total.
3. 'Needs review' sheet: blank cells, duplicate rows, text in number columns, and files whose column names differ, each with the reason.

Don't change any values; only flag things that look wrong on the 'Needs review' sheet.
Name the file {{결과파일명}}.xlsx.

[Calculation & print rules]
- Put every calculated cell in as an Excel formula, not a typed number, and add a cell note explaining the calculation in plain words (visible on hover).
- Add a 'Check' sheet that recalculates the key totals a different way and shows whether they match.
- Print setup: Letter or A4 landscape, fit all columns on one page width, repeat the title row, page numbers in the footer.
